user.title: Bitpanda Setup
user.description: Enter your Bitpanda API key. You can create one in your [Bitpanda account settings]({api_key_url}).

currency.title: Select Currency
currency.description:
Select the currency used for all prices and wallet values.

⚠️ This setting cannot be changed later. To use a different currency, you will need to remove and re-add the integration.

wallets.title: Wallets
wallets.description: Select the wallets you want to monitor. Leave empty to skip — you can configure this later in the integration options.

price_tracker.title: Price Tracker
price_tracker.description: Select the assets you want to track. Leave empty to skip — you can configure this later in the integration options.

price_tracker.title: Price Tracker
price_tracker.description: Add or remove assets to track their live prices.

wallets.title: Wallets
wallets.description: Add or remove wallets to monitor their current value.
